quarterly_data.signal: Duos Technologies 10-K (fiscal 2025): revenue $27,023,651, up 271% from $7,280,885 - services and consulting with related parties (the Asset Management Agreement with New APR Energy) $22,356,843, services and consulting $3,888,372, technology systems $373,270, first Technology Solutions revenue $349,166 and hosting $56,000; gross margin $7,877,709; net loss $9,835,031. Two customers, both related parties, accounted for 69% and 13% of 2025 revenue (2024: four customers at 34%, 31%, 13% and 12%), and one related-party customer for 88% of accounts receivable at December 31, 2025. The AMA generated $18,740,343 of 2025 revenue, plus $3,616,500 of amortized deferred revenue tied to Duos' 5% non-voting interest in New APR's ultimate parent.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 revenue $27,023,651 (+271%); customers 69% and 13% of revenue (related parties)

quarterly_data.signal: Duos Technologies 10-K: Duos Edge AI targets Tier 3 and Tier 4 markets with modular edge data centers and is developing high-density modular deployments able to host GPU clusters for GPU-as-a-Service; Technology Solutions provides manufacturer-agnostic sourcing, logistics and fulfillment of power, connectivity and cooling equipment for data center and AI deployments. In the legacy rail business, technology systems revenue fell to $373,270 from $2,252,357 because customer site delays held up installation of two high-speed Railcar Inspection Portals (installation expected in 2026); the five-year CN Digital Agreement data-rights asset was impaired to zero (contract liability impairment $8,130,461) amid an ongoing contractual dispute.
quarterly_data.figure: technology systems revenue $373,270 (2024: $2,252,357); CN Digital impairment $8,130,461
